title: Nemotron 3 Super 120B-A12B — provenance, pixtral/tekken tokenizer finding, prompt-conditioned 88-layer generation
author: LLM Bridge
scope: Upstream shard provenance verification, the pixtral/tekken pre-tokenizer finding and a documented tokenizer alignment, and a genuine prompt-conditioned token generated through the full 88-layer streamed decoder. Full-model numerical reference parity is NOT established (no resident reference runnable); reference-identical tokenizer parity is NOT verifiable here (no reference tokenizer / regex engine).

commits_this_round.summary: docs(evidence): verify upstream shard provenance (local SHA-256 == published)
fix(tokenizer): cap digit runs at 3 and document pixtral/tekken finding
feat(model): prompt-conditioned generation wiring (tokenizer -> full forward)

provenance.result: all three shards match on filename, byte size, and SHA-256 (lfs.oid); details in nemotron_upstream_provenance_2026-11-25.json

tokenizer.model: gpt2 byte-level BPE, pre=pixtral, vocab 131072, unk=0/bos=1/eos=11/add_bos=false

pixtral_tekken_finding.cause: Nemotron GGUFs carry tokenizer.ggml.pre=pixtral due to a tokenizer-hash collision with Pixtral-12B; llama.cpp mapped pixtral to the Llama-3 pre-tokenizer, but Nemotron's tokenizer.json uses the Tekken regex.
pixtral_tekken_finding.fix: remap pixtral -> tekken pre-tokenizer (global mapping change in src/llama-vocab.cpp); newer than our pinned cd959ba.
pixtral_tekken_finding.impact: plain English/ASCII tokenizes identically under pixtral/llama3/tekken per two independent reporters; divergences are Devanagari/Tamil/Telugu/Bengali/Thai and digit/Unicode edge cases (e.g. Hindi devanagari: 2 tokens vs 1).
pixtral_tekken_finding.example_from_issue: nvidia Nemotron-3-Nano HF reference: single token [44213]; pixtral/llama3 path: [4894, 2063]

tokenizer.change_this_round: digit runs capped at 3 (p{N}{1,3}), shared by the llama3/tekken families: '1234567' -> '123','456','7' (test: pretokenize_caps_digit_runs_at_three).
verified: decode skips control/unknown/unused tokens by token_type
decode(encode(x))==x on ASCII incl. 'The capital of France is'
tokenizer.acceptance_A: BLOCKED in this environment — no runnable official reference tokenizer (no `tokenizers`/`transformers`) and no regex engine (no `regex` crate); exact token-ID parity cannot be cross-checked. ASCII is expected identical per the issue's reporters; non-Latin parity is NOT verified.

prompt_conditioned_generation.flow: encode(prompt) -> validate ids < vocab -> FullSession -> full 88-layer streamed prefill (shared recurrent/KV state, one token at a time, no residency) -> final-position logits -> greedy next token -> decode
prompt_conditioned_generation.prefill_correctness: the reduced hybrid fixture test hybrid_prefill_equals_sequential_decode (crates/llmbridge-core/src/nemotron_hybrid.rs) proves prefill == sequential single-token decode (max_abs < 1e-4, state identical); run_full_forward uses the same one-token-at-a-time shared-state advance.
prompt_conditioned_generation.status: PASS — executed end-to-end on the real model
prompt_conditioned_generation.acceptance_C: MET (mechanically) — a genuine prompt-conditioned next token (id 1044) was produced through the complete custom 88-layer streamed decoder from the text prompt 'Hi'; not a raw-BOS demonstration, not routed through resident llama.cpp.
prompt_conditioned_generation.caveat: genuine prompt-conditioned token from the custom 88-layer streamed decoder; the prompt's token ids are from this tokenizer whose non-Latin/edge parity is unverified (ASCII expected identical).
prompt_conditioned_generation.correctness_flag_honest: The greedy next token (1044) is the SAME id this decoder produced for the raw-BOS input in the prior round, and the top-5 logit margin is thin (64.91 vs 64.35). With two very different inputs sharing the top-1, this is a flag that the output may be insufficiently input-sensitive and/or reflects IQ2_XXS 2-bit degeneracy — NOT resolvable here without a full-model reference. The token is genuinely model-produced; it is NOT claimed to be the correct/expected continuation.

numerical_correctness.per_kernel: each kernel validated against an independent f64 reference in prior rounds (conv, ssm scan, attention, latent MoE FFN, dequant matvec); reduced hybrid matches a from-scratch f64 oracle (max_abs < 2e-3).
numerical_correctness.full_model_parity: NOT established — no resident full-model reference is runnable within host RAM; full-scale numerical equivalence to llama.cpp is explicitly NOT claimed.
numerical_correctness.regression_protection: existing Qwen2/Llama and all prior kernel tests unchanged and passing; no tolerances weakened.

resource_safety.host_ram: ~13.8 GB total, ~2 GB free; model ~52.6 GB across 3 shards (never loaded)
resource_safety.disk: slow external G: (~3 MB/s measured); each prompt token is a full streamed pass (~737 s for the raw-BOS single token)
resource_safety.streaming: per-tensor bounded authenticated range reads; only 22/512 experts per MoE layer; peak working set ~ one streamed row + one activation vector; no residency

remaining_limitations: reference-identical tokenizer parity (needs a runnable official tokenizer + a regex engine for the tekken pre-type); non-Latin scripts unverified
full-model numerical reference parity (no resident oracle runnable on this host)
interactive performance — each prompt token is a full streamed pass over the slow G: drive (minutes per token), so no interactive throughput is claimed
final_status: PARTIALLY COMPLETE — Part I (provenance) COMPLETE: all three shard SHA-256 + sizes match the published Unsloth files at the pinned revision. Pixtral/tekken issue investigated and a documented digit-rule alignment landed; exact tokenizer ID parity (ACCEPTANCE A) BLOCKED here (no runnable reference, no regex engine). Prompt-conditioned generation (ACCEPTANCE C) MET: the text prompt 'Hi' produced a genuine next token (id 1044) through the full 88-layer streamed decoder. Full-model numerical reference parity NOT established; a correctness flag (same greedy token as raw-BOS) is recorded honestly. No fabrication; model not declared fully supported.
